name: train-27b-1
status: not launched: no calibration of this model on the v1 environments exists, the trainer has not run at this model size, and the launch needs the owner's word

model.reasoning: reasoning_effort=medium (the setting of the calibration; the calibration decides it, see section 2)
model.lora_targets: all linear layers of the language model; the vision tower excluded

environments.rule: train on the (environment, level) cells where the calibration finds a pass rate in [0.20, 0.60] with at least 80 % of the groups of 8 mixed

untrained_environment.choice: the first of this list that is admitted by the stored gate at launch and has a level with a calibrated pass rate in [0.05, 0.80]

splits.calibration: public train split, seeds 9000-9031 per level
splits.train: public train split, a fresh seed for every group from 10000 (mrgym.curriculum)
splits.dev: public dev split, seeds 0-31 per trained cell, 2 episodes each
splits.test: secret split test-iid (MRGYM_SECRET_FILE), seeds 0-149 per cell, 2 episodes each, opened once

algorithm.name: GRPO over whole episodes, verl pinned 8357f1e, colocated synchronous trainer
algorithm.reward: the environment's paid reward: 1 for a pass, else 0

arms.name: R1
arms.what: RL from the base model on the calibrated cells, bandit curriculum, paid reward

arms.name: R2
arms.what: as R1, another seed; started only after R1 has passed stop rule F1

arms.name: B
arms.what: the base model, evaluated through the same agent loop on the same held-out instances

model_dims.source: config.json of the model repository (vocab, hidden, layers, mlp) and its file sizes on the Hub (55.6 GB), read 2026-11-24

rollout.source: verl's own launcher for a 27B model of this family (examples/grpo_trainer/run_qwen3_5_27b_fsdp.sh at the pinned commit: GEN_TP=4, 0.6); KV size: estimate from the configuration, never measured by us

actor.source: arithmetic on the dimensions; gradient checkpointing on, bf16 autocast; the logits term is 1 copy when the in-place cross-entropy is available and up to 3 otherwise. Not measured

gpu_s_per_episode_generation.source: measured: Qwen3.8-27B, 768 episodes of 12 tool turns on Scanner/NoWrap-v0, vLLM 0.33 at 2 x TP4 with speculative decoding, 8 x H100 (job s01 of the project record, 2026-11-24). Not measured on the v1 environments, and not with a LoRA adapter loaded

lora_serving_slowdown.source: assumption: the serving script of the project drops speculative decoding when an adapter is loaded; never measured

tokens_per_episode_trained.source: the cap of this plan (max_prompt_len + max_response_len); the 27B's v0 episodes had a median of 40k completion tokens, so most episodes are expected at or near the cap until the calibration says otherwise

trained_tokens_per_s_per_node.source: 8000: a LoRA run of this model in another trainer on 8 x H200 (the project record); 4000: a pessimistic bound for H100. Never measured in this stack

completion_tokens_per_reply_elsewhere.source: measured: this model at reasoning effort medium, 256 code-repair episodes of up to 40 turns (job r02 of the project record, 2026-11-24). Another kind of task; not measured on any v1 environment. Used for scale in the text only, in no table

eval_overhead_s_per_launch.source: estimate: loading the 27B into the actor and two rollout replicas
